mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN ACCOUNTS account_asset ON account_asset.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN CARDS card_asset ON card_asset.card_id = t.card_id LEFT JOIN CONNECTIONS account_connection ON account_connection.connection_id = account_asset.connection_id LEFT JOIN CONNECTIONS card_connection ON card_connection.connection_id = card_asset.connection_id

AND ( ( t.account_id IS NOT NULL AND account_connection.user_id = t.user_id AND account_connection.status = 'ACTIVE' AND account_connection.deleted_at IS NULL ) OR ( t.card_id IS NOT NULL AND card_connection.user_id = t.user_id AND card_connection.status = 'ACTIVE' AND card_connection.deleted_at IS NULL ) )
mapper.select:
SELECT t.transaction_date AS date, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN t.type = 'EXPENSE' AND t.category NOT IN ('CARD_WITHDRAWAL', 'SEND', 'INCOME', 'LOAN_REPAYMENT') THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS totalExpense, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'INCOME' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalIncome FROM TRANSACTIONS t
WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.type IN ('EXPENSE', 'INCOME') AND t.transaction_date BETWEEN #{condition.startDate} AND #{condition.endDate} AND ( t.type = 'INCOME' OR t.category NOT IN ('CARD_WITHDRAWAL', 'SEND', 'INCOME', 'LOAN_REPAYMENT') )
GROUP BY t.transaction_date ORDER BY t.transaction_date ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE TRANSACTIONS SET category = #{category}, category_source = 'USER', category_confidence = 1.0000, classifier_version = 'user-v1' WHERE transaction_id = #{transactionId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND type IN ('EXPENSE', 'INCOME', 'TRANSFER') AND category <> 'CARD_WITHDRAWAL'
mapper.select:
SELECT t.transaction_date AS date, t.transaction_time AS time, CASE WHEN t.category IN ('OTHER', 'ETC') THEN 'ETC' ELSE t.category END AS category, t.amount, t.merchant_name AS merchantName FROM TRANSACTIONS t
WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.type = 'EXPENSE' AND t.category NOT IN ('CARD_WITHDRAWAL', 'SEND', 'INCOME', 'LOAN_REPAYMENT')
ORDER BY t.transaction_date ASC, t.transaction_time ASC, t.transaction_id ASC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'INCOME' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS monthlyIncome, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN t.type = 'EXPENSE' AND t.category NOT IN ('CARD_WITHDRAWAL', 'SEND', 'INCOME', 'LOAN_REPAYMENT') THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS monthlyExpense FROM TRANSACTIONS t
WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.type IN ('INCOME', 'EXPENSE') AND t.transaction_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND ( t.type = 'INCOME' OR t.category NOT IN ('CARD_WITHDRAWAL', 'SEND', 'INCOME', 'LOAN_REPAYMENT') )
